entities.name: Elżbieta Drużbacka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Elżbieta Drużbacka was a Polish poet of the late Baroque period. Little is known of her life. She learned French at the court of Elżbieta Sieniawska. She married a Jewish man, and had two daughters, After she was widowed, she moved to the Bernardine monastery at Tarnów, where she died. Her best known work is Opisanie czterech części roku.
